turns.message: I ordered a laptop backpack on the Flipkart app. When the parcel arrived on July 4, 2022 it was empty: no backpack, no bill and no warranty card. I reported it in the Flipkart app straight away and asked for a refund. Flipkart asked for my ID and my consent to use my information, and I gave both. My refund request has still been rejected three times without any explanation.

expected.rationale: No exact purchase, cancellation or return date is stated (the delivery date is not one of the decision dates).

## How this may relate to your case

- An e-commerce entity must establish a grievance redressal mechanism and display the name, contact details, and designation of the grievance officer.
- A seller cannot refuse to take back goods, withdraw services, or refuse to refund if the goods or services are defective, deficient, or spurious, or do not match the advertised features.
- An inventory e-commerce entity must accept returns, withdraw services, or refund if the goods or services are defective, deficient, or spurious, or do not match the advertised features, except in cases of late delivery due to force majeure.
